notes: All required story categories (schema, core logic, API, integration, tests) already covered. Minor evidence correction applied.

change_log.note: Expanded evidence to include provider-related schema alignment

stories.title: Define Evaluate Care Facade Request/Response Schema
stories.description: Define unified Pydantic request/response contract with operation enum (clinical_trials_search, provider_detail), normalized inputs, and a consistent response envelope (status, data, errors, metadata) supporting forward-compatible extensions.

stories.title: Implement Facade Orchestration Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic routing, aggregation, normalization, and error standardization across clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service with consistent envelope output and graceful degradation on partial failures.

stories.title: Expose Evaluate Care Facade via Tool Router Interface
stories.description: Expose facade through tool_router with strict Pydantic validation, operation dispatch, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use loop, enforcing allowlist constraints (GOV-004).

stories.title: Cross-Domain Integration and Aggregation Validation
stories.description: Validate multi-service aggregation scenarios ensuring consistent schema output when combining clinical trials and provider detail data, including partial response stitching, precedence rules, and null-handling.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Facade Orchestration
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering schema contract validation, routing logic, error handling, and full tool_router execution paths for both clinical trials search and provider detail flows.
